sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Ready-made views of an entity's edits: All edits, Own edits, Edits by others, Open edits, Open edits by others, jesus2099's searches from SUPER MIND CONTROL Ⅱ X TURBO (only this entity's edits, pure edits, on a release without art and art only, relationship edits with Post-NGS and Pre-NGS, effective edits, edits I have not voted on) and the Annotation history. Each opens in the preview window, titled after itself; Ctrl-click or middle-click opens MusicBrainz's own page.
The ☰ SAED menu has a new 'Editing history' group on a page about one entity: '✎ Entity history ▸' lists those views, and '📝 Annotation history' opens the annotation's versions.
The window's '✎ Editing history' button is now a button with a menu: the button opens all edits as before (or H), its ▾ lists the same views. An editor's window keeps the plain button.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: An editor's collections page with a 'Collaborative collections' section: those collections were drawn under 'My collections' with one cell too many, so from the Privacy column on every value stood under the wrong header. The page now shows one 'Collections' section: each collaborative collection joins the sub-table of its kind, and every sub-table has a Privacy column ('Private' for the editor's own collections, MusicBrainz's own value such as 'Public' for the collaborative ones).
The same page: every sub-table showed the first one's column names, so the count column read 'Artists' everywhere. Each sub-table now has its own (Recordings, Releases, Release groups, Series).

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Brucebase year pages: the 📊 list of the Media column now shows each name's icon after it (Photo, Setlist, Ticket, …), the same icon the table shows. An entry for a cell with several icons stays text only.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: The non-MusicBrainz site settings are now on by default: springsteenlyrics.com, jungleland.it, brucespringsteen.it, Brucebase (song list and year pages) and discogs.com are switched on, and so are the detail previews of the four Springsteen sites, the compact category and filter bar on springsteenlyrics.com, and 'In the window, read a link ahead while the pointer rests on it'. 'Show the Brucebase side bar on the right' and the '… on touch devices' settings stay off. A profile that still holds the old off value from the old default is moved to the new one once, as with earlier default changes; switch a site off again in ⚙️ Settings if you do not want it.
